description.value: Days Inn Vancouver Downtown is an 85-room heritage hotel housed in a building dating to 1918, located in Vancouver's downtown core near Gastown, Canada Place, and Waterfront Station. The property retains original wood flooring and old-world charm while offering on-site dining at the Chelsea Restaurant and the Butcher & Bullock pub. It sits within easy cycling distance of the Stanley Park seawall, a 10 km loop that circumnavigates the park.
